notes: Ludum Dare 42 jam entry (Dearth of Mana) by JBarrows. Complete Unity 2018.2.1f1 project under src/DearthOfMana with a playable SampleScene listed in EditorBuildSettings, grid/orb gameplay scripts (GameBoard, ManaOrb, DeadOrb, GridOrb, ScoreDisplay, BGTileCollection), prefabs, and sprites. Unlicense (public domain dedication at repo root LICENSE). No bundled fonts, no third-party plugins, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no LFS, no DLL/EXE. Omitted upstream DearthOfMana/WebBuild/ (compiled web zip and index.html). ~320K src snapshot after omitting WebBuild.
